archetypes.name: dyn-verdict-gates
archetypes.rationale: Verdict mode has several conservative gates whose ordering and report/exit consistency are critical.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new ground-truth verdict path in python/analyze_issues.py. Focus on whether gate_result and gate_reason are assigned inside calibration before rendering, whether the wrapper only reports that result, and whether degraded enrichment, targeted fetch failures, corpus shortfall, and #5461 shipped detection cannot produce a false GO. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-run-dir-joins
archetypes.rationale: The change rewires filed-OOS and accepted-evidence matching from basename run_id to log-root-relative run_dir_key.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review run_dir_key threading across iter_filed_oos_records, implement/design record builders, GroundTruthRow, GroundTruthEvidence, filed-OOS matching, and accepted-evidence dedupe. Look for any path that still emits or matches by basename alone and could cross-contaminate design/run-1 and implement/run-1. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-verdict-docs
archetypes.rationale: The feature has a committed NO-GO artifact and multiple user-facing docs that must align with CLI semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review README.md, docs/skills.md, docs/point-competition.md, docs/ground-truth-verdict.md, and the analyze-issues skill prose. Check that documented defaults, no-op filter behavior, strict started_at filtering, #5461 closed-with-PR gate, and NO-GO artifact match the implemented CLI behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
